visual fields (perimetry): full
2. Pupillary examination, including assessment for an afferent pupillary defect
pupil size and light reaction: equal and reactive
3. Complete ocular-motility examination with cover testing and assessment of ptosis
nystagmus: direction and whether it changes with gaze: no nystagmus
smooth pursuit and saccades: rapid conjugate HORIZONTAL saccadic oscillations WITHOUT intersaccadic intervals - ocular flutter
adduction in horizontal gaze (each eye): full
abducting nystagmus of the fellow eye: absent
vertical gaze and convergence: normal
skew deviation / alternating cover test: no vertical misalignment
ocular torsion and head tilt: none
ptosis / lid position: none
4. Dilated fundus examination
fundoscopy: normal
5. Noncontrast CT scan of the head
CT head (non-contrast): normal
6. CT angiography of the intracranial and cervical vessels
CT / MR angiography (posterior circulation): normal
CT / MR angiography (circle of Willis): normal / non-contributory

MRI brain with gadolinium: normal

Alternative: Post-traumatic ocular flutter
